-- Add 4 new columns to leads table (Lead Conductor Phase 1)
ALTER TABLE leads
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS automationPaused TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS automationPausedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS automationPausedBy VARCHAR(100) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS automationPauseReason VARCHAR(255) NULL;

-- Create leadSequenceQueue table (Lead Conductor Phase 1)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leadSequenceQueue (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  leadId INT NOT NULL,
  scheduledFor TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  channel ENUM('email', 'sms', 'call_reminder', 'internal_task') NOT NULL,
  sequenceKey VARCHAR(100) NULL,
  touchKey VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  touchSubject VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  touchBodyTemplate TEXT NULL,
  touchBodyOverride TEXT NULL,
  status ENUM('scheduled', 'processing', 'sent', 'skipped', 'cancelled', 'failed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled',
  skipReason VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  cancelReason VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  failureReason TEXT NULL,
  sentAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  skippedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  cancelledAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  failedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  createdBy VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system',
  updatedBy VARCHAR(100) NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT fk_lsq_lead FOREIGN KEY (leadId) REFERENCES leads(id),
  INDEX dispatch_idx (scheduledFor, status),
  INDEX queue_lead_idx (leadId),
  INDEX queue_touch_key_idx (leadId, touchKey, status)
);
